annotations.text: The loop: pick a mode off the rotation, build a kit, fight for three minutes, get paid, spend it, climb the week.

The one idea underneath all six screens.

Alpha already deals every spawn 30 random greens (spawn_prizes = 30). A kit is those same thirty, chosen instead of rolled. Nothing is added, so bounty still reads 30 and the balance harness still works.

The pips on this screen actually spend.
Match maps set prize_max = 0, so there is nothing on the field to scavenge. Your kit is the whole ship. The open arena keeps greens, where the kit becomes your floor rather than your ceiling.
Round points bank one for one as rivets. Points already cannot be taken by death, so this needs no new rule.
Rivets buy what you may slot, never how much. Everything trades against the same thirty.
Rating is the career ladder and moves slowly. The week is the short one, and resets on Monday.
